headline: The 30 Most Important Questions and Answers on Eligibility for the Diesel Subsidy
summary: Eligible people will receive the 20,000 forint diesel subsidy automatically, without a separate application. The first instalment is due on 30 September 2026, according to the National Tax and Customs Administration.
why: Fuel subsidies change household fuel costs and government spending, which affects Hungary's budget and its consumer demand. Investors track such measures for their fiscal impact.
